name: One&Only One Za'abeel
positioning: City hotel in the heart of Dubai, set in the One Za'abeel towers and linked by The Link, a sky concourse with a suspended infinity pool on its roof
best_for: Travelers who want a high-rise city base near Dubai's business and finance hubs
Wellness-minded guests interested in longevity treatments at the Clinique La Prairie spa
Families who want pools and a kids' club in the city

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Dubai, on the doorstep of the city's business, finance, fashion and cultural hubs.
Za'abeel is an affluent area in Bur Dubai on the border of Dubai International Financial Center, close to Downtown Dubai.
Dubai World Trade Centre is a short walk from the hotel.
The architecture is by Nikken Sekkei and the design by Jean-Michel Gathy's Denniston.
The hotel is set in the One Za'abeel building, connected by the sky concourse The Link for destination dining.
Rooms have glass curtain walls that draw the eye to the horizon.
Even entry-level rooms have a king-sized bed, a daybed and a bathroom with a standalone tub; Grand category rooms add a separate dressing room.
The spa is set over three floors and offers aesthetic and wellness treatments alongside longevity analysis.
The spa has a hammam and hydrotherapy area, a steam room and a sauna.
The infinity pool is suspended on the roof of The Link, with views toward the Burj Khalifa.
There is a separate couples' pool.
Tapasake is a Peruvian-Japanese indoor-outdoor restaurant with pool deck dining on top of The Link.

highlights.text: The hotel has the UAE's longest suspended infinity pool.
The hotel sits in one of two towers linked by a cantilever.
The spa is a Longevity Hub by Clinique La Prairie, the first in the Middle East.
In The Garden on level four, Bali-inspired rice-paddy-style family pools have a swim-up bar.
Sanctuary Suites are themed corner suites with their own treatment room.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the hotel is in a business district rather than on the beach.
Complimentary early check-in and late check-out are a suite benefit, subject to availability.
Dubai International Airport is a 15- to 20-minute drive; the hotel can arrange luxury transfers.
